_comment: gosec configuration. Single source of truth for the exclusions used by both .github/workflows/pr.yml (hard gate) and ci.yml (informational). Keep them in sync by pointing both at this file rather than repeating --exclude flags. Do not set global.nosec or global.audit here: gosec reads "nosec": "enabled" as ignore the #nosec annotations, which resurfaces findings that carry a written justification in the source.

_exclusions.G104: Unhandled errors. Deliberate on os.Stat probes during config discovery and on deferred Close of read-only files, where there is nothing to recover from.
_exclusions.G301: Directory permissions. Only reached from test helpers creating temporary trees.
_exclusions.G306: WriteFile permissions. Only reached from test helpers writing temporary config fixtures.
